title: Session 2026-11-05, answer engine doubled, 3 new satellites live, two truth gates, deploy pipeline fixed
verdict: MCP revenue is still $0. Stripe cannot be read (the CLI holds no keys) and no real card has ever been through checkout. Google impressions on mcpstamp.com rose to 143 a day (6 on 10-30), and question pages are the only kind ranking on page one, so this session put about 40 more honest answer pages live. There are 18 new can-Claude pages with real server calls, 3 live-data pages, 15 can-ChatGPT pages and 3 can-Cursor pages. They came from 1,491 real Google autocomplete questions. Two independent truth gates found 29 false claims in the drafts, mostly 'Claude cannot', when code execution is on by default. All were fixed before deploy, as was the same error on 10 older pages. The zip page title now answers the query directly. Three new free live-data satellites went live: UV index, FDA drug shortages, census tract. Each has a Worker, public repo, registry entry and site page, for 30 in total. Community PR #96 was merged and #97 got a review. Two awesome-list PRs were opened. Two traps were fixed. The local site tree was 22 commits stale and would have reverted production (publish.sh now refuses), and the CI artifact lacked site/lib, which failed the first production deploy.
